summary: Iteration 5: read-only and UI testing only. No bets, users, deposits, withdrawals or config changes were made, and the data-creating pytest suites were not run. (1) Admin Game tab: admin-fair-upcoming ('Mode 3 · Next 10 results (admin only)') sits directly below Game configuration and lists 10 consecutive rounds (#426 (current) to #435), each with result, dice and published hash. There are 10 admin-fair-result-<n> cells. config-mode-select shows 'fair' and offers 'Mode 3 · Fair Proof'. (2) API consistency: the 10 admin fair_upcoming hashes are identical to the 10 player1 /api/game/fair upcoming hashes. The user payload has no dice/result/salt leak (keys: number, committed_at, hash). The first upcoming round equals the current round. In two separate runs, rounds 422/423 and 428/429 finished with exactly the result, dice and hash the admin saw beforehand (/api/game/history and /game/fair revealed). All 19 used seeds verify as SHA256(number:dice:salt). (3) User game page at 390x844: no nav-fair-proof icon, no minority or fair-proof text, scrollWidth 390 = clientWidth, scrollHeight 844 = clientHeight, the footer ends at 844, and the whole layout fits on one screen. (4) Sound: /game-music.mp3 is served (200, audio/mpeg, 657KB). After a neutral click the HTMLAudio is playing (paused=false, currentTime about 4.5s) and the AudioContext state is 'running'. music-toggle-button pauses it (localStorage oe_music=off), a click while off keeps it paused, and toggling back resumes playback (currentTime advancing, oe_music=on). Bet and win sounds were reviewed in code only: playBetSound runs after a successful bet POST and playWinSound runs on a won round. They were not triggered because no bets were allowed.

issues: During the 3s reveal phase, current round N's seed is already 'used', so the list starts at N+1 and no row shows '(current)'. This is cosmetic and expected.

critical_code_review_comments: GET /api/admin/game and GET /api/game/fair call ensure_commitments, so GET requests write to the database (only system fair_seeds upserts, which are idempotent). That is acceptable, but GET handlers with side effects are worth noting.
The single 'AbortError' from HTMLMediaElement.play on mount comes from the React StrictMode/dev double-mount cleanup (the first Audio's src is cleared). It is harmless.
The AudioContext is created lazily on the first gesture (unlockAudio). playWinSound depends on a prior gesture, which is fine because the user must click Place Bet to win.
seed_data_creation: None. Only login sessions were created, plus the fair_seeds commitments the server generates itself.
context_for_next_testing_agent: The user forbids test data. Use backend/tests/readonly_fair_check.py (read-only: logs in admin+player1, compares admin fair_upcoming with user /game/fair hashes, waits about 60s for 2 rounds and checks history). The mode is 'fair' and must stay that way. Login testids: login-username-input, login-password-input, login-terms-checkbox, login-submit-button. Admin testids: admin-username-input, admin-password-input, admin-login-button, admin-mfa-code-input, admin-tab-game.
